name: SkydropX
long_description:
We automate the shipping process for businesses. Our “AI Dispatch” makes it easier to select, buy/print shipping labels, track, estimate drop-off times and handle returns. We enable 
companies to own the entire experience from shopping cart to delivery.
one_liner: Logistic Management System for E-commerce & Retail in Mexico.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder & CEO @SkydropX  (YCombinator S18)  Logistic Management System for E-commerce & Retail in Mexico. We have raised +$7M USD from investors like Y Combinator, Sierra Ventures, FJ Labs, Variv Capital, Dynamo and more.

Before Founder/CEO of ordering online platform sold to Delivery Hero in 2014. Three countries, 30 employees. Raised $1M USD. 500 Startups MV (Batch 6).
